r13_contract.comparisonModel: Require exactly one polarClassRequirementsApplicable boolean. If true, require valid polarClass evidence and constrain every linked internalIceStrengthenedStructure to have one QuantityValue internalStructureCorrosionAbrasionAddition with decimal numericValue >= 1.0 and exactly one unit:MilliM. If false, the I2.11.3 obligation is non-applicable. The universal rule does not require a structure instance.

test_cases.rationale: Applicable Polar-Class context has one internal structure at the exact 1.0 mm corrosion/abrasion-addition boundary.
Applicable context may exceed the 1.0 mm minimum.
Explicit false applicability makes the I2.11.3 obligation non-applicable even if a represented structure has a smaller value.
R13 explicitly treats the linked structures universally and does not require inventing an internal-structure instance.
